title.zh: 工艺流程：刻蚀前后都要管
title.en: Process flow: manage both before and after etching

subtitle.zh: 前检查、主刻蚀、停止、后处理与验收。
subtitle.en: Pre-inspection, main etch, stopping, post-treatment and acceptance

body.zh: 核心判断：评价一次刻蚀，要包括进片条件和后处理完成后的最终表面。
body.en: Core assessment: evaluate incoming conditions and the final surface after post-treatment

body.zh: 流程位置：承接光刻/硬掩膜或待去除薄膜，输出可进入沉积、金属化等后续模块的晶圆。
body.en: Position in the flow: receive lithography/hard masks or films to remove, and deliver wafers ready for deposition, metallization and later modules

body.zh: 典型干法流程；进片与；温控确认
body.en: Typical dry-etch flow Load wafer and confirm temperature control

body.zh: 4；按终点/时间；控制及所需过刻停止
body.en: 4 Stop using endpoint/time control and required overetch

body.zh: 按整合要求；去胶/去残留
body.en: Strip resist / remove residue as integration requires

body.zh: 典型湿法流程；检查材料与；药液状态
body.en: Typical wet-etch flow Check material and bath condition
Contact the chemical bath and wet fully
4 End contact and perform suitable rinsing

body.zh: 关键控制；• 进片膜厚/掩膜状态；• 停止判据；• 后处理兼容性；• 转序等待时间
body.en: Key controls • Incoming film thickness / mask condition • Stopping criterion • Post-treatment compatibility • Queue time between steps

body.zh: 耦合与失效；• 去残留能力增强时，也可能增加；功能膜损失；；• 缺少有效润湿、停止控制或后处理；会产生局部残膜、过刻、腐蚀或水痕。
body.en: Coupling and failure • Stronger residue removal may also increase functional-film loss • Ineffective wetting, stopping control or post-treatment can cause local residual film, overetch, corrosion or watermarks

body.zh: 后处理后量测；量测反馈；结合进片记录、终点/时间记录；及后处理后的膜厚和缺陷检查，；定位异常来自主刻蚀还是转序；与清洗。
body.en: Metrology after post-treatment Metrology feedback Combine incoming records, endpoint/time records and post-treatment film-thickness/defect inspection to locate whether the anomaly arose in main etching or transfer and cleaning

body.zh: 下一工艺模块；可进入沉积、金属化等；后续模块
body.en: Next process module Ready for deposition, metallization and subsequent modules

body.zh: 下游影响与边界；• 最终表面状态会影响成膜和接触。；• 干法示例以RIE为主；湿法设备；可以是槽式或单片式，去胶、清洗；的具体顺序由材料体系决定。
body.en: Downstream effects and boundaries • Final surface condition affects film growth and contacts • The dry example primarily uses RIE; wet tools may be batch tanks or single-wafer systems; the sequence of stripping and cleaning depends on the material system
